blocks.title: Responsible data sharing
blocks.text: Responsible data sharing means sharing personal or sensitive information only when truly necessary and only with trusted parties.
When applying online for a scholarship, students should enter personal details only on secure, verified websites to prevent misuse.

blocks.prompt: How does responsible data sharing contribute to ethical use of information (short question 7)?
blocks.explanation: It respects people's privacy by sharing only what is needed, with those who need it, through secure channels, which reduces the risk of identity theft, fraud and misuse and keeps the trust of the people whose data it is.

items: Share personal data only when needed, only with trusted, secure parties.
